title: NxFreeze
description: NxFreeze is a lightweight staff plugin that allows admins to freeze/unfreeze players using commands or an easy GUI.
body:
**Native Major MC Version:
1.21
Tested Major MC Versions:
1.161.171.181.191.201.20.61.21
Languages Supported:
English
Version: 1.0
Author: MisterBlock
Main Feature: Player get freeze/unfreeze
Website: Discord– misterblock.exe**

NxFreeze lets staff freeze/unfreeze players instantly with commands or a GUI. Prevents movement, combat, and interaction for moderation control. Supports console commands, bypass permission, and auto-refresh GUI.

✅ Features:
• Freeze/unfreeze players individually or all

• Interactive GUI with left/right click controls

• Auto-refresh GUI every 2 seconds (no sudden reopening)

• Frozen players: cannot move, hit, interact, break/place, drop/pickup, chat, or use commands

• Optional BossBar & sound notification

• Full Configured From plugins

**⚙️Commands:
/Freeze IGN
/Unfreeze IGN
/Freeze (GUI which shows all online player to freeze/unfreeze)

‍️Permisions:
nxfreeze.admin: control all cmds without op if person has!
nxfreeze.bypass: bypass all freeze unfreeze(need to staff person also not work if he/she has only op need this permision To bypass)**
